title: 第六百九十二章 道家思想第六百九十一章 尽管发展
content_zh:
第六百九十二章道家思想
这一夜不知道多少研究天文，研究星辰的研究生，博士或者研究员崩溃大哭。
研究员兴许还没那么绝望。
好歹是国家拨款，星星丢了，说不定还能写个报告，往上报上去，说不定旱涝保收，再拿个奖。
但像是研究了好几年星星的那些博士，研究生，一个个的是真的绝望。
星星爆炸了，好歹还能看到陨石。
但是那一片星空直接清图了，连个陨石都找不到。
这他妈怎么解释？
你可以说看到的星星是十万年前的景象，其实星星十万年前就爆炸了，只不过在你看到的时候才出现在眼前。
但是清空了一片星图，这就不正常了。
宇宙四大基本力。
甚至关于一部分星空的研究，直接就在这卡住了。
用计算来算的话，肯定有问题。
因为不可能有东西凭空消失，更别说像是一片星空中的诸多星辰。
但是确确实实又丢了。
而且中间间隔的时间很短，总不可能说突然出现了一个黑洞，把它们吞了之后又消失了吧？
这注定是个未解之谜。
只不过。
类似的未解之谜好像在近几十年变多了。
原本星空观测站编制好像不太高。

但因为各国每隔几年，好像都能发现的怪异事件，逐渐的提高了保密等级。
又恰逢如今经济发展，乱象四起，精神空虚，有许多所谓的教派宣布什么世界末日，搞什么全球大灭绝。
确实也算是让他们抓住机会掏上了。
……
而就在各个研究机构兵荒马乱的时候。
只见到。
另一边，已经得到了自家师父传音的宋诚则是点了点头，眼神之中，还带着几分的惊喜之色:
“弟子知晓，绝不辜负师父期望。”
刚刚还在跟师兄两个人互相画大饼，看看谁脑瓜子灵光的宋志，看着师兄突然的变化，眼神中露出几分狐疑:
“……师父又跟你说什么了？”
他好歹也已经踏入了行气境界，真的说起来，在这一方世界，也算得上是法天象地的大能。
从现如今情况上来看。
这一方修行界能搞定他的，应当没多少人。
怎么师父还把任务交给师兄？
content_en:
Chapter 692: Taoist Thought
That night, countless graduate students, Ph.D.s or researchers studying astronomy and stars broke down and cried.
The researcher may not be so desperate after all.
After all, it is a state grant. If the star is lost, maybe I can still write a report and submit it to the superiors. Maybe the harvest will be guaranteed despite droughts and floods, and I will get another award.
But those PhDs and graduate students who have been studying the stars for several years are all really desperate.
The stars exploded, but at least the meteorites could still be seen.
But the starry sky was completely cleared, and not even a meteorite could be found.
How the hell do you explain this?
You can say that the stars you see are scenes from a hundred thousand years ago. In fact, the stars exploded a hundred thousand years ago, but they only appear in front of you when you see them.
But if a star map is cleared, this is abnormal.
The four fundamental forces of the universe.
Even the research on part of the starry sky got stuck here.
If you use calculations to calculate it, there must be something wrong.
Because it is impossible for something to disappear out of thin air, let alone many stars in a starry sky.
But it was indeed lost again.
Moreover, the time interval in between was very short. It is impossible to say that a black hole suddenly appeared, swallowed them and then disappeared, right?
This is destined to be an unsolved mystery.
only.
Similar mysteries seem to have increased in number in recent decades.
Originally, the establishment of the starry sky observatory seemed not to be very high.
But because of the strange events that seem to be discovered every few years in various countries, the level of confidentiality has gradually been raised.
It also coincides with the current economic development, chaos and spiritual emptiness. There are many so-called sects announcing the end of the world and engaging in global mass extinction.
It is indeed considered as allowing them to seize the opportunity and pay for it.
…
And just when various research institutions are in chaos.
Only seen.
On the other side, Song Cheng, who had received a message from his master, nodded, with a hint of surprise in his eyes:
"Disciple knows that he will never live up to Master's expectations."
Song Zhi, who was just trying to figure out who had the brightest ideas with his senior brother, looked at his sudden change with a bit of suspicion in his eyes:
"...What did Master tell you again?"
He has finally entered the realm of moving qi. Seriously speaking, in this world, he can be regarded as a powerful man who can control the sky and the earth.
Judging from the current situation.
There shouldn't be many people in the cultivation world who can handle him.
Why did the master still give the task to the senior brother?
